caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a round body, narrow neck, and a curved handle attached from the upper neck to the midsection. The jug has a greyish base color with blue decorative elements. There is a blue band encircling both the upper neck near the lip and the lower base. On the body of the jug, a blue floral motif with swirling stems and leaves is prominently displayed, and on the left side of the decoration, a raised relief figure of a person is present. The entire jug is rendered with careful shading, giving it a three-dimensional, realistic appearance, and it is set against a plain, off-white background. Near the lower right edge of the image, the signature "Carl Buergerniss" is visible.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
